en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Abu Jameela, from Is’haq Bin Ammar and Sama’at, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I said, ‘The consumer of the interest after the evidence (is clarified to him)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be disciplined. So if he repeats, he would be disiplined. So if he repeats, he would be killed’.
